name: Zvenit Yanvarskaya Vyuga
source:
Semyon has been in the camp for some time now, but not in its usual summer colors, rather in a winter palette, swapping grass for snow, heat for cold, and trading his pioneer uniform for his usual coat. Not only him, but the residents of Sovyonok have also found fur coats, jackets, and hats with scarves in their wardrobes. Semyon was passing the time doing nothing until one seemingly unremarkable day, when all the pioneers were heading to the gym to watch a movie, a severe blizzard hit the camp, forcing them to hide in one of the cabins so as not to freeze to death outside. And what happened next is exactly what you are about to find out.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3112567901]Steam[/url]]
